title: Data, Research and Framework for Workplace Policies on After-hours Work Communications
what_it_is: Data, Research and Framework for Workplace Policies on After-hours Work Communications

sections.label: After-hours communication policies and work-life harmony
sections.summary: MOM data shows 55% of full-time resident employees reported employer after-hours communication policies in 2025, with no separate effectiveness assessment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Based on MOM's data, in 2025, 55% of full-time resident employees reported that their employers had policies governing after-hours communication.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: These policies include practices such as not expecting responses to non-urgent messages until the next working day or providing time-off-in-lieu for after-hours work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: We have not conducted a separate assessment of the effectiveness of each of these individual policies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Supporting work-life harmony plays an important role of creating an environment that is conducive to these aspects of Singaporeans' lives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: We will continue to work with our tripartite partners to encourage workplace practices that support work-life harmony, including through the Tripartite Standard on Work-Life Harmony and Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-being at Workplaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: A Marriage and Parenthood Reset Workgroup has also been set up to develop a whole-of-society approach to better support Singaporeans in their marriage and parenthood journeys.

sections.label: Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health
sections.summary: The Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-Being at Workplaces emphasises addressing work stressors like workload and organisational practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: One thing to highlight is the Tripartite Advisory on Mental Health and Well-Being at Workplaces emphasises the importance of addressing work stressors – workload itself and organisational practices – that may affect the overall well-being of employees.

sections.label: Monitoring overseas right to disconnect
sections.summary: MOM is monitoring developments in other jurisdictions, including those with forms of code of practice on the right to disconnect.

sentences.text: On the question on whether MOM has studied overseas on the right to disconnect and some of the approaches, I would like to say that we are monitoring the situation and developments in other jurisdictions including those who have implemented some forms of code of practice.

sections.label: Studying overseas practices for Singapore
sections.summary: MOM will continue to study overseas developments and adapt useful practices for Singapore's context while promoting employer-employee discussions.

sentences.text: And at the same time, promote more constructive employer and employee discussions and relationships and how they can bring more value together.
We will continue to study these overseas developments and if there are of these practices that may be useful, we will most certainly study them and adapt them for Singapore's context.
